title: Cross-tenant document read via GET /documents/{doc_id}
description: An authenticated user from one tenant can retrieve documents owned by a different tenant by requesting the document ID directly. The list endpoint is tenant-scoped, but the single-document endpoint does not appear to enforce tenant ownership.

reproduction.request: GET /documents/1 with X-User-Token of a user in tenant 2
reproduction.observed: HTTP 200 with the body of a tenant 1 document

source: synthetic finding for a controlled test target
